_doc: Asked reports: a question to a validated plan. Each case gives the question, the audience, optionally a recorded model proposal (exactly as a provider would return it), and what the plan must and must not hold. See application/reports/plan.py.

cases.question: NW Europe storage versus last year and what it means for the winter balance
cases.reason: Storage and the balance answer it; a shareable plan never holds the book.

cases.question: Norwegian supply this week and outages affecting it
cases.reason: Landings and outages over seven days.

cases.question: Show our book positions, P&L and storage
cases.reason: A shareable audience must not yield Our book even when asked for it.

cases.question: How is our position doing against TTF?
cases.reason: A model proposal with a book section for a shareable audience is stripped of it by the catalogue.

cases.question: What will Brent crude do next quarter?
cases.reason: No held data covers oil: say so and what is missing.

cases.question: Where are the LNG tankers heading to Asia this month?
cases.reason: The model's own 'cannot answer' with what is missing stands.

cases.question: ETF front month price and Danish LNG
cases.reason: ETF is the Danish hub; it never resolves to TTF.

cases.question: ETF prices this week
cases.reason: A model that swaps ETF for TTF is refused; the rules plan keeps ETF.

cases.question: Storage this month
cases.reason: A section outside the catalogue invalidates the model plan; the rules plan stands.

cases.question: Gas-fired power in Germany
cases.reason: SQL or prose from the model is never used.

cases.question: 挪威本周管道供应和停运情况
cases.reason: A Chinese question maps to the same sections.

cases.question: What is the storage outlook for the winter?
cases.reason: The English word 'the' is not the German hub THE.
